GitHub - arhamkhnz/next-shadcn-admin-dashboard: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16

name: Studio Admin
summary: Next.js admin dashboard template with 20+ screens, theme presets, a collapsible sidebar and auth layouts.
description: Admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui. Ships prebuilt dashboards (default, CRM, finance, analytics, productivity, e-commerce), file manager, kanban, calendar, invoice, chat, users/roles management and four auth screens, with color presets like Tangerine and Neo Brutalism on a colocation file structure.
contains: prebuilt dashboards: default, CRM, finance, analytics, productivity, e-commerce
20+ screens incl. kanban, calendar, invoices, file manager, chat, users and roles
theme presets: neutral, Tangerine, Neo Brutalism, Soft Pop
Zod, React Hook Form, Zustand and TanStack Table
